keys:
Enter: End Turn

F: Find Selected Unit. Currently selected unit will be centered on screen.

-,+: Zoom In, Out

G: Turns on Grid Display

F1: Centers on Tagged Unit

Arrow Keys: Scrolls the map

ALT-P: Pause the game

ALT-F: Opens the Load/Save Game Menu

ALT-L: Use to quick load a game

ALT-S: Use to quick save a game

ALT-X: Exits the Game to the Main Menu

ALT-F5, ALT-F6, ALT-F7, ALT-F8: Saves the current window position

F5, F6, F7, F8: Jumps to a previously saved window position

?: Initiates HELP mode.  The cursor changes to a question mark, clicking on screen items will display help text.

ALT-C: Saves a screen shot of the game in PCX format.

Shift: Hold the Shift key while selecting units to create groups.

Shift-Done: Holding the Shift key while clicking on the Done button will start in motion all units that are waiting to move along a path.

CARGO_SETUP.name: BUY_BUTTON

FACTORY_BUILD_SETUP.text: Choosing the Build X1 button will build the selected unit at normal speed and lowest cost.

FACTORY_BUILD_SETUP.name: BUILD_BUTTONx2
FACTORY_BUILD_SETUP.text: Choosing the Build X2 button will build the selected unit at twice the normal speed, but will use more materials than normal.

FACTORY_BUILD_SETUP.text: Clicking the Build button will start the factory building the first unit in the Build Window. As each unit is completed, the factory will automatically begin constructing the next unit in the list.

FACTORY_BUILD_SETUP.text: Clicking the Repeat button will continuously repeat building the units in Build Window above.

GAME_SCREEN_SETUP.name: HITS_BUTTON

GAME_SCREEN_SETUP.name: SCAN_BUTTON

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: NEW_GAME_LABEL
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: The New Game Setup Screen allows you to select your clan and the human and computer players for this game.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: TEAM_LABEL
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Up to 4 Teams can play, One Human vs. as many as 3 computer opponents. To play another human on the same computer, go back to the Main Menu and select Multiplayer, then select Hot Seat Game.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: HUMAN_LABEL
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Select one box in this column for the Human Player.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: COMPUTER_LABEL
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Select one box in this column for the Computer Player.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: NONE_LABEL
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Select a box in this column for No Player on this team.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: CLAN_LABEL
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Click on the active button to select your Clan.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: NUMBER_LABEL
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: These numbers represent the 4 Teams possible. Click in the columns to designate human and computer players.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: HUMAN_BUTTONS
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Clicking one of the buttons in this column assigns a human player to that team.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: COMPUTER_BUTTONS
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Clicking one of the buttons in this column assigns a Computer player to that team.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: NONE_BUTTONS
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Clicking one of the buttons in this column assigns No Player to that particular team.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: CLAN_BUTTONS
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Clicking a clan button opens the Clan Menu, and allows you to review the various clans and select one to fight for.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: OPTION_BUTTON
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Opens the Options Menu, and allows you to set up various game settings, such as Victory Conditions, Starting Credits and Map Resource Distribution.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: CANCEL_BUTTON
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Cancels New Game Selection, and returns to the New Game Menu.

NEW_GAME_SETUP.name: DONE_BUTTON
NEW_GAME_SETUP.text: Closes the New Game Start Menu, and proceeds with the game.

OPTIONS_SETUP.name: COMPUTER_OPPONENT
OPTIONS_SETUP.text: This Panel allows you to select the difficulty level of your computer opponent(s). Each level, when clicked, will display information about that opponent's abilities.

OPTIONS_SETUP.name: TURN_TIMERS
OPTIONS_SETUP.text: The Turn Timer Panel allows you to change the values for the TURN TIMER, and the END TURN TIMER. As each turn is started, the TURN TIMER resets and starts counting down to zero, until the end turn button is clicked. The END TURN TIMER then begins counting down to allow your opponent(s) time to finish their turns.

OPTIONS_SETUP.name: PLAY_MODE
OPTIONS_SETUP.text: M.A.X. may be played in normal Turn Based Mode, where each player takes their turn in sequence, or in Simultaneous Mode, in which all players take their turns at the same time.

OPTIONS_SETUP.name: STARTING_CREDIT
OPTIONS_SETUP.text: This panel allows you to select the amount of Credits that will be available to purchase and/or upgrade units at the beginning of the game.

OPTIONS_SETUP.name: RESOURCE_LEVELS
OPTIONS_SETUP.text:
The Resource Panel allows you to select the overall amount of Raw Materials, Fuel and Gold that will be available on the planet.

Alien Derelicts: Alien Units are sometimes found on the planet and can be optionally added to Custom Games. When first encountered, Alien units do not belong to any team and must be captured by an Infiltrator before they can be used. Note that computer opponents will also attempt to use any Alien Units they find if the Computer Opponent difficulty level is set to Expert or higher. If set below Expert, the computer will attempt to destroy any alien vehicles it encounters.

OPTIONS_SETUP.name: VICTORY_CONDITIONS
OPTIONS_SETUP.text: Victory Conditions can be set up based on the number of turns or as the number of points accumulated. You may select one of the options presented, or click in the field, and then type in the desired victory limit.

OPTIONS_SETUP.name: CANCEL_BUTTON
OPTIONS_SETUP.text: Clicking Cancel closes the Options Menu and returns you to the previous menu.

OPTIONS_SETUP.name: DONE_BUTTON
OPTIONS_SETUP.text: Once all options are set to your satisfaction, click the Done button to proceed with the game.

PLANET_SETUP.name: PLANET_LABEL
PLANET_SETUP.text: The Planet Selection Screen allows you to view the various planet maps and choose one for the current game.

PLANET_SETUP.name: PLANET_NAME
PLANET_SETUP.text: The type of planet maps available is displayed in this window.

PLANET_SETUP.name: PLANET_WINDOW
PLANET_SETUP.text: This window displays a representative world in this class of planets.

PLANET_SETUP.name: ARROW_BUTTONS
PLANET_SETUP.text: Clicking the arrow buttons will cycle through the available classes of planets.

PLANET_SETUP.name: MAP_WINDOWS
PLANET_SETUP.text: These windows display the maps of different worlds. Click on the map you wish to select, then click "Done."

PLANET_SETUP.name: DESC_WINDOW
PLANET_SETUP.text: This window displays the currently known information about the selected planet.

PLANET_SETUP.name: CANCEL_BUTTON
PLANET_SETUP.text: Cancels any changes to planet selection.

PLANET_SETUP.name: DONE_BUTTON
PLANET_SETUP.text: Approves the planet selected and proceeds with the game.

PLANET_SETUP.name: RANDOM_BUTTON
PLANET_SETUP.text: Click the RANDOM button to have the computer select a map at Random.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: DISABLE_MUSIC

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: DISABLE_VOICE

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: VIDEO_VOLUME

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: DISABLE_VIDEO
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: Click this button to turn off the video playback sound.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: AUTO_SAVE
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: The "Auto-Save" feature automatically saves your game. The number signifies how often the game will be saved. A value of (1) means the game will be saved every turn.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: PLAYER_NAME
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: Use this field to enter your name for use in Multiplayer Games.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: ANIMATE_EFFECTS
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: Clicking "Animate Effects" turns the unit animations on and off. If you're playing the game on a slower computer, turning off the animations will increase the speed of the game.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: FAST_UNIT_MOVES
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: When checked, the "Double Unit Steps" will cause your units to move at a faster pace across the game screen, rather than at the normal realistic speed.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: ENEMY_SPOTTED
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: When checked, this feature will immediately halt any moving unit as soon as an enemy is detected by its radar. If a unit is part of a group then the entire group will stop also. When unchecked, the unit will continue to move until it reaches the end of its path or its speed points are exhausted.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: QUICK_SCROLL
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: The position of the slider indicates the rate at which the screen will scroll. Positioned to the right will scroll quicker. Positioned to the left will scroll slower.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: CLICK_TO_SCROLL
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: When checked, the "Click to Scroll" button requires the left mouse button to be held in order to scroll the map window. When not checked simply moving your mouse cursor to the edge of the map will scroll it.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: FOLLOW_UNIT
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: When the "Track Selected Unit" button is checked, the screen will automatically scroll to follow the movements of the selected unit.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: AUTO_SELECT_UNIT
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: When "Auto-Select" is on, the game will automatically switch to the next unit when the selected unit has run out of movement points.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: TURN_TIME
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: The Turn Timer sets the amount of time allowed for each turn.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: END_TURN_TIME
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: The "End Turn Time" sets the amount of grace time given to players once one player has ended turn.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: CANCEL_BUTTON
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: Click the "Cancel" button to cancel any changes and return to the game.

PREFS_MENU_SETUP.name: DONE
PREFS_MENU_SETUP.text: Click the "Done" button to save any changes and return to the game in progress.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: MAIN_DISPLAY
REPORTS_SETUP.text: The Reports Window displays a variety of information, depending on the type of report selected from the buttons on the upper right of the screen. The UNIT Report displays information about each of your units. The CASUALTIES Report displays information on all enemy and friendly unit losses. The SCORE Report displays a graph of each team's present score. The MESSAGE report displays the last 50 Computer and Chat messages.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: TURN_TIMER
REPORTS_SETUP.text: The Turn Timer displays the time remaining for the current turn. Turn timer values can be adjusted in the Options Menu in the New Game Setup Screen.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: UNITS_BUTTON
REPORTS_SETUP.text: Clicking the UNITS button will open the Units Report, which displays information on the Statistics, Location, and Status for every unit under your command.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: CASUALTY_BUTTON
REPORTS_SETUP.text: Clicking the CASUALTIES button will open the Casualty Report, which displays a listing of each team's destroyed units.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: SCORE_BUTTON
REPORTS_SETUP.text: Clicking the Score button presents a graph depicting each team's score. The numbers going up the left side of the graph are the number of turns. The horizontal row of numbers at the bottom represent points. The dark gray bar depicts the current turn. The graph also projects scores 10 turns into the future.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: MESSAGES_BUTTON
REPORTS_SETUP.text: Clicking the MESSAGES button displays a listing of the past 50 messages sent by the computer, as well as Chat messages received from any remote human opponents.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: INCLUDE_LABLE
REPORTS_SETUP.text: The INCLUDE buttons are filters affecting which types of units are included in the UNITS and CASUALTIES Reports. Click on the filter buttons to add or remove items from the reports display.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: AIR_UNITS_SWITCH
REPORTS_SETUP.text: When ON (highlighted) Air Units will be included in the UNITS and Casualties Reports.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: LAND_UNITS_SWITCH
REPORTS_SETUP.text: When ON (highlighted) Land Units will be included in the UNITS and Casualties Reports.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: SEA_UNITS_SWITCH
REPORTS_SETUP.text: When ON (highlighted) Sea Units will be included in the UNITS and Casualties Reports.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: STATIONARY_UNITS
REPORTS_SETUP.text: When ON (highlighted) Stationary Units will be included in the UNITS and Casualties Reports.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: LIMIT_TO_LABEL
REPORTS_SETUP.text: The LIMIT Buttons below limit the reports display to the types of units specified. Any combination of Limit Buttons may be active at the same time.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: PRODUCTION_SWITCH
REPORTS_SETUP.text: When ON (highlighted) units capable of production will be displayed in the UNITS and CASUALTIES Reports.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: COMBAT_SWITCH
REPORTS_SETUP.text: When ON (highlighted) Combat Units will be displayed in the UNITS and CASUALTIES Reports.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: DAMAGED_SWITCH
REPORTS_SETUP.text: When ON (highlighted) Damaged Units will be displayed in the UNITS and CASUALTIES Reports.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: STEALTHY_SWITCH
REPORTS_SETUP.text: When ON (highlighted) Stealthy Units (units which are invisible to most other enemy units) will be displayed in the UNITS and CASUALTIES Reports.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: DONE_BUTTON
REPORTS_SETUP.text: Click DONE to close the Reports Display.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: UP_ARROW
REPORTS_SETUP.text: Click the UP ARROW to scroll upwards through the report.

REPORTS_SETUP.name: DOWN_ARROW
REPORTS_SETUP.text: Click the DOWN ARROW to scroll down through the report.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: TITLE_BAR
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This is the Research Center. Here, you may specify which Topics you wish to investigate. Each Center may research one topic at a time; however, you may build multiple Research Centers and research several areas simultaneously. Alternatively, you may assign several research centers to work on the same topic to speed development. Unlike Upgrades, which affect one type of unit at a time, technology gained by research can affect the attributes of many or all your units at the same time.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: LABS_LABEL
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This column displays the number of Labs (Research Centers) performing research in a given area. You may change research topics for any Lab by clicking the scroll bars to increase or decrease the number of Research Centers investigating a Topic.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: NUM_ATTACK
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This window displays the number of Research Centers currently investigating ATTACK. 'Attack' is the overall power of each shot fired by a unit.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: NUM_SHOTS
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This window displays the number of Research Centers currently investigating SHOTS. 'Shots' is the number of shots a unit can fire per turn.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: NUM_AMMO
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This window displays the number of Research Centers currently investigating AMMO. 'Ammo' is the maximum number of shells the vehicle can carry.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: NUM_ARMOR
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This window displays the number of Research Centers currently investigating ARMOR. 'Armor' relates to the strength and quality of the unit's armor plating.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: NUM_HITS
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This window displays the number of Research Centers currently investigating HITS. 'Hits' is the amount of damage a unit can endure (not including armor) before it is destroyed.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: NUM_MOVEMENT
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This window displays the number of Research Centers currently investigating MOVEMENT. 'Movement' relates to the distance a vehicle can travel in one turn.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: NUM_SCAN
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This window displays the number of Research Centers currently investigating SCAN. 'Scan' is the distance a unit can see.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: NUM_PRICE
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: This window displays the number of Research Centers currently investigating COST. COST is the relative amount of Materials and the amount of Time (Turns) it takes to build units.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: ARROWS_ATTACK
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: Use this scroll bar to control the number of Research Centers investigating ATTACK. 'Attack' is the overall power of each shot fired by a unit.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: ARROWS_SHOTS
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: Use this scroll bar to control the number of Research Centers investigating SHOTS. 'Shots' is the number of shots a unit is capable of firing each turn.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: ARROWS_AMMO
RESEARCH_SETUP.text: Use this scroll bar to control the number of Research Centers investigating AMMO. 'Ammo' is the maximum number of shells the vehicle can carry.

RESEARCH_SETUP.name: ARROWS_ARMOR
